data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of a **LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED** unit of yours is picked for a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**.

**Target:** That same **LEGIONES DAEMONICA MOUNTED** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit in Engagement Range of the unit is picked for a fall-back move, it must use **[desperate escape mode](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape-2)**, and if it is **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**, its [hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls) get -1.

effects.appliesTo: enemy units engaged with the target when selected to fall back

durationBasis.name: Persisting Rules Effects
durationBasis.reason: the card prints no duration, so the effect lasts only for the phase in which it was applied
